name: gates-docs
description: Docs-drift commit gate and docs-consolidation trigger. Denies a git commit that changes code without staging its covering docs (per-plugin README/CLAUDE.md pairs, or the nearest README/CLAUDE/AGENTS walking up), with a docs-sync:ack escape. A never-blocking Stop/UserPromptSubmit pair counts commits since the .docs-sync record and nudges toward the /docs-consolidate skill. GATES_DISABLE turns either off.
